Richmond Chocolate Frosting
 
Save Print
Author: Amy Simonsen
Recipe type: Dessert
Cuisine: American
Ingredients
  • ½ Cup(s) sugar
  • 1½ Tablespoon(s) cornstarch
  • 1 Pinch(s) salt
  • 1 baking chocolate square
  • ½ Cup(s) boiling water
  • 1½ Tablespoon(s) butter
  • ½ Teaspoon(s) vanilla
Instructions
  1. Mix sugar, salt, and cornstarch together in small saucepan with a fork. Add chocolate square and water and cook on medium high heat while stirring constantly. Once the mixture thickens* (should be like thick like pudding), remove from heat and add butter and vanilla. Let cool and spread on cake.
  2. *If the frosting isn't thickening when the mixture comes to a full boil, remove frosting pan from heat. In a separate small bowl, mix 1 tablespoon more cornstarch with a little water. Add the cornstarch water to the frosting, return pan to heat and stir.
